DIFFICULTY AUDIT

Are our static difficulty labels lying to us?

This page compares each question's hand-assigned difficulty against its Elo-recalibrated difficulty (derived from live attempt data). Questions where the two disagree are flagged mislabeled — use this to fix content tagging before it misleads students on pacing.
